business_problem: CRRC needed a practical AI acceleration method for industrial simulation, because traditional aerodynamic simulation software was too slow and compute-intensive to support fast design iteration for next-generation high-speed rail products.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud designed an enterprise large-model solution for CRRC's MaaS platform and then applied it to industrial simulation, image analysis, and quality workflows. The baseline stack supports language, image-generation, computer-vision, and multimodal models, and it was deeply adapted to CRRC's domestic GPU environment, dedicated container cloud, and service interfaces for trainable and inferable package delivery. On top of that general foundation, the joint team built the aerodynamic simulation large model 'Zhulun Fengchi.' The solution combines a data-driven simulation model, an efficient compute framework, and intelligent application tools so engineers can modify train exterior designs and receive aerodynamic outputs in seconds rather than waiting a full day. This turns aerodynamic analysis from a batch process into a real-time design companion and shows how CRRC can use one industrial AI platform for NLP, agents, visual analysis, quality inspection, and simulation-heavy R&D workloads.

solution_components.name: MaaS Platform
solution_components.role: Hosts Baidu's enterprise large-model suite in CRRC's domestic GPU and container environment so multiple AI applications can be delivered through one industrial platform.

solution_components.name: Zhulun Fengchi
solution_components.role: Provides the aerodynamic simulation large-model workflow that gives rail engineers near-real-time simulation results during train-design iteration.

data_flow: Industrial design and simulation data feed CRRC's MaaS platform, Baidu's large-model suite and the Zhulun Fengchi simulation model run on the adapted domestic-GPU environment, and the resulting outputs flow back into train-design, quality-inspection, and broader industrial AI workflows.
business_outcome: CRRC turned aerodynamic simulation into a real-time engineering tool, improved industrial AI readiness across multiple model types, and created a stronger base for rail-equipment innovation and quality workflows.
metrics: simulation time reduced from 24 hours to 10 seconds
